units.source_text: “呀，真个一无所长的女人，谁也不会受骗而向她求爱的。

en.t: Well, if a woman truly had nothing to recommend her, no one would be deceived into courting her.

units.source_text: 完全一无可取的与完全无瑕可指的，恐怕是同样地少有的吧。

en.t: A woman with absolutely nothing to praise and one with absolutely no flaw to find are probably equally rare.

units.source_text: 有的女子出身高贵，宠爱者众，缺点多被隐饰；

en.t: Some women are of noble birth and have many admirers, so their faults are mostly hidden.

units.source_text: 闻者见者，自然都相信是个绝代佳人。

en.t: Those who hear of them or see them naturally believe they are peerless beauties.

units.source_text: 其次，中等人家的女子，性情如何，有何长处，外人都看得到，容易辨别其优劣。

en.t: Next, with women from middle-ranking families, outsiders can see what their temperament is like and what merits they have, so it is easy to judge their strengths and weaknesses.

units.source_text: 至于下等人家的女子，不会惹人特别注意，不足道了。”

en.t: As for women from lower-ranking families, they do not attract any particular notice and are hardly worth discussing.
